Join the AI Community of Practice for its weekly gathering on Dec. 17, 2025, at 10 a.m. in your local community center. This event offers a platform for enthusiasts and professionals to explore the latest developments in artificial intelligence. Attendees can participate in engaging discussions, share insights, and collaborate on projects. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, this gathering provides a welcoming environment to enhance your knowledge and network with like-minded individuals. Don't miss this opportunity to connect and innovate in the rapidly evolving field of AI.
